newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FACTFILE ON FORMER COVENTRY CITY MANAGER ATKINSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FACTFILE ON FORMER COVENTRY CITY MANAGER ATKINSON.

text.p: Following is a factfile on Ron
Atkinson, who on Tuesday stepped down as manager of
English premier league side Coventry City.
1939: Born March 18, Liverpool.
1956: Joined Aston Villa as an apprentice.
1962: Moved to Oxford.
1971: Appointed player-manager of Kettering.
1974: Named manager of Cambridge.
1978: Became manager of West Brom.
1981: Appointed manager of Manchester United.
1981-86: Took United F.A. Cup final victories in 1983 and
1985 but was sacked the following year.
1987: Returned to West Brom as manager.
1988: Named manager of Spanish club Atletico Madrid but
lasted only three months.
1989: Appointed manager of Sheffield Wednesday.
1991: Joined Aston Villa.
1991-94: Steered Villa to UEFA Cup triumph over holders
Inter-Milan in 1994 but suffered eight defeats in nine league
matches and has his contract terminated.
1995: Appointed manager of Coventry.
1996: Steps aside as Coventry manager and becomes the club's
director of football.
